chapter.name: Bob
chapter.title: Other people's handwriting
chapter.stamp: Course Journal, Q1b · “Do you fit your definition?”

lines: Six Flights never gives you a score.
On Saturday, your teammates take the notebook and write in it themselves,
and that's your only feedback: what your choices were like for them.
There are twenty-seven different weeks, and I hope you play more than one.
Someone once told me to increase my surface area:
try more things, because that's how you find what fits.
There's no right answer here, but every choice lands on somebody.

big.text:
Hear it from
the people you led.
